title: Disabled Reason
summary: Keeps a blocked control focusable and explains exactly what blocks it, with a jump to each fix, so disabled buttons aren't dead ends.
description: Keeps the control focusable with aria-disabled and explains on hover, focus or tap what blocks it, in a portalled panel no toolbar can clip, with a jump to each fix, a shake when a blocked press lands and cleared blockers sliding away.
catches: Disabled buttons that give no reason
Every blocker at once, with a link to fix each
Presses on a blocked control, acknowledged with a shake
limits: Only lists the reasons you pass; it doesn't validate the form
Don't also set `disabled` on the child, or it can't receive focus
a11y: Sets aria-disabled on the child instead of disabled, so it stays focusable
Adds aria-describedby to the reasons while blocked
Opens on focus as well as hover and tap
The shake and list animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
stops: Disabled button with no reason given
